text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Starting this year, Agnes Tachyon and I
will be
challenging senior races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We decide to visit the shrine for New
Year's Day
to offer our prayers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I still haven't told Agnes Tachyon that,
for the
upcoming year, I've planned out
an ambitious
agenda with the aim of
dominating the medium
distance G1
races and the Grand Prix.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What were you so fervently wishing for?
choice_data_list: （彼女の限界を超える一助になれば……！）
choice_data_list_en: (If only this can help her push past her limits...!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I was meaning to discuss this with her in
person
later. But since she asked, I
divulge the details of
my prayer.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh-heh. So, we're dominating the
medium
G1 races and the Grand Prix
now?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That would include the Osaka Hai, the

Takarazuka Kinen, the autumn Tenno
Sho, and
the Arima Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You're a greedy guinea pig. Might you
be putting
too much faith in the gods?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, this is the first I'm hearing
about this
race agenda.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I brace myself for her response.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Very well! Not a bad idea!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon grins with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh! Plan A went well, so we must
go on the
offensive this year! Lest our
efforts be for naught!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I assure you that I'll go at it with
everything I have
at my disposal. You
can consider your wish
realized!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hearing such a bold declaration out of
Agnes
Tachyon, my mind can't help but
wander back to
one year ago.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What do we have here? "The Classic
Triple
Crown."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's our goal for this year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's our goal for this year.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Like I've been saying, I can't guarantee if
I will
actually race or not.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Compared to back then, her reply now is
nigh
unthinkable.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, quit being so sentimental. Over
several
hundred billion of our cells
undergo death and
rebirth on a daily
basis. Naturally, we too would

experience change.
choice_data_list: タキオンも変わったなぁ
タキオンも変わったねぇ

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Though that isn't to say I don't
understand what
you mean.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Last year was one full of twists and
turns—a year
to remember for certain.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Let bygones be bygones. Now that we've
finished
our New Year's shrine visit, shall
we head back?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: No, training.
choice_data_list_en: Do you have research to do?
Do you have research to do?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It isn't often that our interests are fully
aligned,
so I thought to make the most
out of it.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Don't you agree?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Take it easy, you say. Hmm, that is a bit

unexpected.
choice_data_list: せっかくだからのんびりしよう
帰ってトレーニングだ！
choice_data_list_en: Since we have the chance, let's take it easy.
Time to train once we get back!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
But I suppose, sleeping away the New
Year's
holiday for a try doesn't sound all
that bad.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
As it's New Year's, what do you say we
try to find
a hammock on sale?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, didn't you know? The swaying of a
hammock
is proven to have a positive
effect in helping one
de-stress.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later, we go shopping for hammocks at
the DIY
store and promptly put them to
good use.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Either way, this year looks to be an
eventful one.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Fortune slips, huh? Unexpected, but
intriguing.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'm curious to see how markings on a
mere slip of
paper might affect mental
changes in my guinea
pig.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah yes. Through this, I can study the
extent at
which you put your faith in the
divine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I politely refuse her sudden survey.
Either way,
this year looks to be an
eventful one.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Now we're talking!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
We have much to do. Last year was a
busy one
full of twists and turns.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
This year will be one of great strides
toward
success!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With all the excitement behind her
smile, I can't
help but nod in kind. This
year looks to be an
eventful one!
